_readme: Best fit of the physical Tom to a tom recording of unknown provenance, from cmd/fit-physical. NOT a validated acoustic calibration and NOT the shipped default: it misses all three adoption-gate terms (partial frequency 48.9 cents against 25, partial decay 0.573 against 0.25, spectral envelope 11.1 dB against 4). Re-derived 2026-08-01 on the right channel under the corrected glide estimator, which had been reading a partial that was dead before the late probe and so fitted every earlier bank against a reference bend of +89.3 cents instead of the true one. Totals from before that fix are not comparable to this one: the bank this file replaced was reported as 11.252 and scores 18.991 when re-measured here. See docs/physical-measured-fit.md. Nothing in the test suite depends on the recording, which is gitignored.
